hypothesis: capturing fixed-shape long-prefill chunks in CUDA Graph could close the vLLM long-prefill gap by removing host launch stalls

contract.profile_role: causal upper-bound evidence only; profiler timing is not admission timing

timeline.interpretation: CUDA API durations overlap GPU execution and are not additive wall time; only device timeline gaps bound a graph-only gain.

decision.reason: Even impossible removal of every observed device gap has only a 5.17% speedup ceiling and explains at most 14.7% of the matched no-profiler TTFT deficit. The remaining critical path is GPU attention/GEMM work, so a full prefill graph executor is not the primary next rewrite.
decision.next_action: Screen the already archived causal FA2 path at a long-only exact trajectory gate when no higher-priority job is queued; if it still changes tokens, keep that branch closed and reconstruct an exact attention data-path rewrite rather than optimizing launch count.
